introHtml: Tangle hand sanitizer offers a unique, twistable bottle design that stands out on any desk or counter. Unlike standard pump bottles, the compact Tangle shape makes it easy to carry in a pocket or bag, ensuring your team or event attendees always have sanitizer on hand. Custom imprinting on the bottle provides a practical branding opportunity that gets noticed every time someone reaches for a squirt.
